parameters.toolDescription: Search free-text crop growing advice using semantic similarity — pest management, disease control, soil notes, climate description, irrigation guidance, and general growing tips. Use this for descriptive, "how do I..." or advice-style questions that don't map to a single exact number. Do NOT use this for precise numeric lookups such as pH, spacing, seed rate, yield, or duration — use get_crop_ideal_ranges for those instead. Do NOT use this for fertilizer amounts or application schedules — use the fertilizer schedule tool for those instead.

Look up precise numeric growing parameters — pH, spacing, seed rate, yield, duration — for a specific named crop, from the crop_ideal_ranges table. Use this when the question asks for exact numbers or ranges. Do NOT use this for pest management, general growing advice, or fertilizer amounts — use the vector store tool or a fertilizer tool for those instead
parameters.query:
SELECT parameter, min_value, max_value, unit, source_note, crop, crop_id
FROM crop_ideal_ranges
WHERE crop ILIKE '%' || '{{ $fromAI("crop", "The crop name mentioned in the user's question") }}' || '%'

parameters.toolDescription:
Description:

Look up the fertilizer application schedule for a named crop — urea, TSP, and MOP amounts (kg/ha) by growth stage (e.g. basal, top dressing at specific weeks/months). Use this when the question asks specifically about fertilizer quantities, nutrient amounts, or application timing. Do NOT use this for general soil requirements, pH, or non-fertilizer growing conditions — use get_crop_ideal_ranges for those. Do NOT use this for pest, irrigation, or other advice-style questions — use the vector store tool instead
parameters.query:
SELECT stage, urea_kg_ha, tsp_kg_ha, mop_kg_ha
FROM crop_fertilizer_schedule
WHERE crop ILIKE '%' || '{{ $fromAI("crop", "The crop name mentioned in the user's question") }}' || '%'
AND stage ILIKE '%' || '{{ $fromAI("stage", "Optional growth stage mentioned, e.g. basal, 3 weeks. Leave empty if not specified") }}' || '%'

parameters.toolDescription: "Fetches the most recent live soil sensor reading — moisture, temperature, pH, EC, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium — for the current device. Always call this when the user asks about current or live soil condition, or wants to check if present conditions suit a crop. Never ask the user to type sensor values manually — this data comes from the tool."
parameters.query:
SELECT device_id, timestamp, moisture, temperature, ph, ec, n, p, k
FROM soil_readings
WHERE device_id = 'field-a-01'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;
